partnerPage.heroDesc: BidVex provides licensed auctioneers, bankruptcy trustees, and liquidators with a modern platform to run their sales — at a flat 3% platform fee.
partnerPage.benefit1Desc: The lowest rate in the industry. No tiered pricing, no hidden charges, no surprises.
partnerPage.benefit2Desc: Full control over your margin. Configure custom buyer premium rates per auction — 10%, 15%, 18%, or any rate.
partnerPage.benefit3Desc: Stand out with a trust badge on every listing. Show buyers they are dealing with a licensed professional.
partnerPage.benefit4Desc: Hammer price and buyer premium are transferred directly to your bank. No waiting, no intermediaries.
partnerPage.mathDesc: On a $50,000 liquidation sale, you pay BidVex $1,500. On other platforms, that same sale costs $4,000 — $7,500.
partnerPage.mathSub: You keep your buyer premium. We only charge 3% of hammer price. All payment processing fees are transparently passed to the buyer.
partnerPage.formSubtitle: Submit your credentials for review. All fields are mandatory.
partnerPage.formCertHint: (Auctioneer license, Trustee credentials — max 10 MB each)
partnerPage.formDisclaimer1: By submitting, you confirm all documents are authentic and verifiable.
partnerPage.formDisclaimer2: Our team will review your application within 24-48 hours and contact you at
partnerPage.feeLine1: Annual Platform Fee: $100.00 CAD/year flat fee for Partner-level access. GST/QST applied.
partnerPage.feeLine2: Hammer Price Commission: 3% platform fee on the final hammer price of every item you list. GST/QST applied.
partnerPage.feeLine3: Buyer's Premium: You set your own BP rate independently — it is not subject to the 3% commission.
partnerPage.feeFootnote: All fees are in Canadian Dollars (CAD). GST and QST are applied on top of all platform fees.
partnerPage.verificationNote: Verification Required: Partner accounts are subject to manual verification of your business registration (NEQ) before you may list vehicles or other items on BidVex. Expect 24-48 hours for review.
partnerPage.signInPrompt: Sign in to your BidVex account to submit an application.
